array_schema.fragment_vocab: str array of fragment IDs (index mapping)
array_schema.patch_A_ids: int32 — patch ID within fragment A
array_schema.patch_B_ids: int32 — patch ID within fragment B
array_schema.contact_overlap_A: float32 — fraction of patch A in contact zone
array_schema.contact_overlap_B: float32 — fraction of patch B in contact zone
array_schema.center_dist_mm: float32 — Euclidean distance between patch centres

recommendation: Use pairs.npz exclusively for Phase 5 training. Original JSON files may be retained as backup but should NOT be loaded during training due to 50×+ slower load time.
